name: SFS Cavalcade Asia-Pacific 2026
venue: City University of Hong Kong, Lau Ming Wai Academic Building (Kowloon Tong)
submission_requirements: Paper must not be accepted or conditionally accepted at a journal; papers presented at WFA, AFA or SFS Cavalcade North America are allowed; each paper may be submitted only once; accepted authors must attend their session.
submission_fee: USD 75 (non-refundable; waived for PhD-only author teams)
registration_fee: Early (through 1 Nov): SFS members USD 150 / non-members USD 190; regular (from 2 Nov): members USD 175 / non-members USD 215; waived for PhD students and CityUHK faculty
keynotes: Xavier Giroud (Columbia Business School); Jun QJ Qian (Fudan University)
journal: Optional dual submission to the Review of Corporate Finance Studies or the Review of Asset Pricing Studies
